json_schema.description: A weave session handoff summary. The plan's dual-write-then-replace decision for memory: the summary is still written to .sprawl/memory (authoritative until M6) AND recorded here. The BODY is not in this payload — it is a content-addressed artifact referenced by the event's artifact_id, because a handoff document routinely exceeds the 8KiB payload CHECK. summary_sha256 ties the event to the memory file even when the artifact could not be written (degraded mode).
